meta: Aqua HK spent HK$5,891 on Meta for 12 schedules, double the 6 booked the prior week (~HK$491 CPA).
Dim Sum Library kept Meta light at HK$1,006 for 4 schedules, up from 3, at ~HK$252 CPA.
Meta stays a thin channel: 16 schedules combined against 342 GA4 bookings.
google: Aqua HK Google is the workhorse: HK$10,379 spend and 83 booking conversions at HK$125 CPA, inside the good band.
Dim Sum Library Google delivered 65 conversions on just HK$1,246 spend — the cheapest acquisition at HK$19 CPA.
Google now drives roughly a third of the two venues' GA4 bookings.
ga4: Aqua HK rebounded to 201 bookings from 164, beating the 185 target, but sits -7.1% behind YTD.
Dim Sum Library recovered to 141 from 130 yet missed the 172 target by 18%, and is -6.2% behind YTD.
DSL user CVR of 14.6% stays strong, so the shortfall is traffic rather than conversion.
